name: pdf-proof
title_zh: PDF 里哪个数在哪一页，截图圈给你看
tagline_zh: 核对合同、报表、聊天记录里的数字时，不用再翻页找半天。它直接定位到那一行，高亮截图，让你拿着图去对质。
tagline_en: Cross-checking numbers in contracts or reports? It jumps to the exact line, highlights it, and hands you a.
desc_en: Use this skill when the user needs visual proof that specific values exist in a PDF — not just to read a PDF, but to see exactly where a number, amount, clause, or field appears on the page with a highlighted screenshot. Trigger when someone is cross-referencing a PDF against something else (a form they're filling out, a claim, a conversation, another document) and needs confirmation with evidence
why_zh: 不是摘要，不是引用——它把视觉证据直接钉在页面上。你看到的就是对方看到的。
why_en: No summaries, no quotes—it nails visual proof right on the page. What you see is what they see, ending the 'go check page X'.
limit_zh: 只认 PDF 文件内的文字层；扫描版或图片型 PDF 需先经 OCR 才能用。高亮截图止于单页。
limit_en: Text-layer PDFs only; scanned/image PDFs need OCR first. Highlights are per-page—multi-page continuous paragraphs aren't stitched together.
title_en: Pinpoint a value in a PDF with a highlighted screenshot
